content: A source document is a record where data collected during a clinical trial is initially documented. This data is typically transferred later into the case report form (CRF). According to the International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH-GCP) guidelines, source documents are defined as original documents, data, and records. These documents contain what is referred to as source data, which is defined as all information in original records and certified copies of original records of clinical findings, observations, or other activities in a clinical trial that are necessary for the reconstruction and evaluation of the trial. It is important to note that the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) does not provide a specific definition for the term source document.
